summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Docking Vestibule. Opening image: Docking vestibule. The StarTrust Operations Liaison steps onto Stardust with one compact case and no entourage. Middle image: Astra gives the smallest professional smile. Closing image: Jax checks the first route clearance.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Docking vestibule. The StarTrust Operations Liaison steps onto Stardust with one compact case and no entourage.
PANEL 2 — Astra meets them with Jax slightly behind, route slate in hand.
PANEL 3 — Astra gives the smallest professional smile.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison almost smiles.
PANEL 5 — Jax checks the first route clearance.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Jax leads a real working tour rather than a presentation. Middle image: the relocated bins become the first test of local judgment. Closing image: the Liaison accepts the documented decision without conflict.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax leads the Liaison through an operations level that is clean enough to move through but visibly working, not staged.
PANEL 2 — They pass the properly racked collection bins; the Liaison asks whether this was the original placement.
PANEL 3 — Jax explains the blocked-access problem and shows the documented local override on his route slate.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison simply says good; Jax, prepared for an argument, has nowhere to put the rest of his defense.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: These were in the original location?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Astra brings the Liaison into the lab work area where Mira has sealed samples and physical test records ready. Middle image: The Liaison looks at her. Closing image: The Liaison nods once.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra brings the Liaison into the lab work area where Mira has sealed samples and physical test records ready.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison sets down the case.
PANEL 3 — Astra answers before Mira can.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison looks at her.
PANEL 5 — Astra continues.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison nods once.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I can show you samples, conditions, tests, chain of custody. I can't make it happen on demand.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Good. If you could, I wouldn't need to be here.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Lab Work Area, continuing from the first sample review. Opening image: the evidence is physically bounded on the bench. Middle image: the Liaison asks for the missing predictor directly. Closing image: uncertainty is treated as usable information rather than failure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira lays out the retained samples and physical test cards in a clean row while the Liaison keeps their hands off the evidence.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison asks for a condition that reliably produces high-cohesion material; Mira answers with the shortest possible no.
PANEL 3 — Mira expands only as far as the records support: physical context, different properties, no predictive behavioral mechanism.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison writes that limitation down without trying to improve it.
PANEL 5 — Mira notices the exact wording and relaxes slightly.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: What reliably produces the high-cohesion material?

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: We know the physical context. We have different samples. We do not have a behavioral predictor.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Glorp shows what the station does record. Middle image: Kreeb shows what it deliberately does not require. Closing image: the Liaison treats the distinction as something to interrogate, not overturn.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp presents the local material-traceability workflow at the same bench.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb points to the intentional no-entry path for personal disclosure while Glorp keeps the sample fields visible.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison notes that this choice created review questions; Glorp braces but answers that questions can be answered.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb's simple yes ends the exchange without turning the privacy boundary into a speech.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: We can trace every sample from collection through testing.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: And nobody has to disclose anything personal to complete the record.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Central review had questions about that.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page at the observation-glass alcove off the working operations level. Opening image: the private conversation stays visually connected to the station's real work. Middle image: the Liaison names the institutional incentive without villainy. Closing image: Astra is asked to define the honest case.
settingText: Observation-glass alcove off Stardust Station's working operations level; bright maintained corporate-station interior with the active lab visible nearby.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison asks Astra aside at the observation glass, with the temporary-bracket status visible across the working level.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison states the funding reality plainly: Stardust needs procurement priority and a material pilot is easier to finance than interesting operations.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks through the glass at the active lab rather than arguing with the premise.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison asks for something they can personally endorse, leaving the question with Astra rather than threatening her.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: A material pilot is easier to fund than “interesting operations.”

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: So give me something I can stand behind.

summary: Primary composition: 3-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: the visitor route collides with a real problem. Middle image: Astra's first instinct is still presentation management. Closing image: she lets the unscheduled event become the tour.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The tour resumes through the galley service corridor just as a low-pressure manifold alert sounds and Zib stops.
PANEL 2 — Astra reflexively offers to redirect the visit upstairs; the Liaison looks at the live alert instead.
PANEL 3 — When the Liaison asks whether this is part of the tour, Astra gives up on smoothing the station and says it is now.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Is this part of the tour?

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Jax checks the planned visitor path. The low-pressure manifold is directly ahead. Middle image: A worker starts to enter the service area. Closing image: Jax looks back at the Liaison.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax checks the planned visitor path. The low-pressure manifold is directly ahead.
PANEL 2 — He closes that route segment and opens a safe bypass on his slate.
PANEL 3 — A worker starts to enter the service area.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison watches him enforce the detour without asking Astra.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks back at the Liaison.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Not through here. Use the blue corridor.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Galley Service Corridor, continuing the live repair. Opening image: diagnosis starts before anybody convenes. Middle image: the fault is isolated physically and conceptually. Closing image: the user-facing consequence is small and explicit.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib opens the manifold cabinet while Mira pulls the sensor history beside him.
PANEL 2 — Mira dates the pressure drop and Zib immediately locates the sticking regulator actuator.
PANEL 3 — Astra asks whether the branch can be isolated without broad service loss.
PANEL 4 — Zib points to the secondary sink branch and gives the problem its actual size.
PANEL 5 — The station announcement takes only Galley Sink Two offline while the Liaison watches the crew refuse to inflate the incident.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Pressure drop started four minutes ago.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: We lose one sink. Nobody dies of thirst.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Zib isolates the affected branch. Middle image: Zib removes the actuator cover. Closing image: The Liaison asks Astra quietly.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib isolates the affected branch.
PANEL 2 — Jax keeps the service path clear and updates the route slate.
PANEL 3 — Mira compares commanded and actual actuator position.
PANEL 4 — Zib removes the actuator cover.
PANEL 5 — Pixa logs elapsed response time and affected service count.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison asks Astra quietly. Astra watches the crew.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Command is clean. Response is lagging.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: One fixture unavailable. No other service impact.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Galley Service Corridor, continuing the repair. Opening image: several small jobs occur simultaneously around the same incident. Middle image: ownership is distributed by function rather than command. Closing image: the Liaison recognizes the station's actual operating pattern.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib cleans the actuator track while Mira verifies response at the cabinet.
PANEL 2 — Jax turns a supply cart away from the open service zone as Astra handles the sink notice and nearby complaints.
PANEL 3 — Glorp logs the isolation while Kreeb posts a plain sign on the unavailable sink.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison sees the distributed response happen at once and asks Astra who is directing it; Astra answers that it depends which part.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We hand everything off fast. Mostly because nobody has enough hands.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Galley Service Corridor, continuing the repair. Opening image: the physical fix is tested. Middle image: operations around the repair return to normal. Closing image: the measured interruption becomes a mundane completed incident.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib cycles the cleaned actuator and pressure returns to the normal band.
PANEL 2 — Mira verifies the trend while Jax reopens the blue-corridor route segment.
PANEL 3 — Pixa posts the total service interruption time as Zib closes the cabinet.
PANEL 4 — Zib blames the extra minutes on having a tour; the Liaison accepts the joke because the repair is complete.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Total service interruption: eleven minutes, forty-two seconds.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Long because we had a tour.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Galley Service Corridor immediately after the repair. Opening image: residue appears as an incidental physical observation. Middle image: the Liaison tests the tempting explanation. Closing image: the sample is preserved without turning it into the story.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — After the repair area is closed and safe, Mira notices a small residue seam near a warm cable junction.
PANEL 2 — She waits until the work is fully clear before sampling, and the Liaison notices the sequence.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison asks whether the material was caused by the disagreement around the repair; Mira rejects the behavioral premise.
PANEL 4 — When the Liaison asks what did cause it, Mira gives the same honest answer as before.
PANEL 5 — Mira seals the sample and rejoins the operational record without giving the residue narrative priority.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: We don't have a behavioral recipe.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: the visit's two evidence streams finally sit side by side. Middle image: the more repeatable result is visibly operational rather than material. Closing image: the Liaison names the season's emerging value proposition.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Back in the lab, the Liaison places the material record beside the operational incident record.
PANEL 2 — The material side reads low mass, variable properties, no defensible predictor; the operations side shows detection, local ownership, isolation and closure.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison points to the second list and says this repeats.
PANEL 4 — Astra initially thinks they mean the failures; the Liaison corrects her: the repeated pattern is the response.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Astra pulls the old inspection result. Middle image: Astra looks slightly embarrassed by the phrase. Closing image: Brick remains at the edge of the room while nobody engages him.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra pulls the old inspection result.
PANEL 2 — The inspector's conclusion is visible: STATION REMAINS ACTIVE — ADAPTIVE RESPONSE ACCEPTABLE.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison reads it.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks slightly embarrassed by the phrase.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison returns the file.
PANEL 6 — Brick remains at the edge of the room. Nobody engages him.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We thought that was a polite way to say “messy but useful.”

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Lab Work Area, continuing the interpretation scene. Opening image: Astra rewrites the pitch in front of Mira. Middle image: the operating record displaces speculative material promises. Closing image: Astra recognizes that the station did not need to become something else to become valuable.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra opens her original material-pilot talking points and begins deleting yield, scale path and production conditions.
PANEL 2 — She replaces them with uptime, response time, local ownership and passive material characterization.
PANEL 3 — Mira points out that this is a different pitch; Astra first calls it a different station.
PANEL 4 — Mira corrects her—same station—and Astra accepts the correction immediately.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: The Liaison closes their case. Middle image: Astra looks at the sample tray, then the operations record. Closing image: The Liaison nods toward the operations record.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison closes their case.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison sets the closed compact case on the lab bench beside the sample tray.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks at the sample tray, then the operations record.
PANEL 4 — Astra keeps the sample tray and the operations record side by side on the bench, one hand braced between them.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison nods toward the operations record.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: I can recommend a limited pilot. Central will ask what it produces.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I'm not selling certainty we don't have.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Then don't sell certainty. Give them the operating record.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: the site terms are built collaboratively rather than delivered from corporate. Middle image: each person contributes the boundary they own. Closing image: the Liaison's qualifier preserves the next institutional conflict.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, Glorp, Kreeb and the Liaison gather around one working document for the local trial terms.
PANEL 2 — Astra enters passive collection only; Mira adds no behavioral conditions.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb adds no personal disclosure required.
PANEL 4 — Glorp preserves complete material chain of custody.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison adds no output target from me; Astra catches the qualifier rather than missing it.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Material chain of custody remains complete.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Lab Work Area, continuing the trial-terms scene. Opening image: Astra sees the first institutional description that resembles Stardust. Middle image: the recommendation still contains a future finance risk. Closing image: the Liaison stays credible by naming the limit of their authority.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison shows Astra the recommendation before sending it: ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS SITE WITH INCIDENTAL MATERIAL CHARACTERIZATION.
PANEL 2 — Astra reads the description twice because it finally resembles the station.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison points to the central-finance note warning that a material benchmark may still be requested.
PANEL 4 — Astra challenges the apparent contradiction; the Liaison distinguishes their own recommendation from central review.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Central finance may still ask for a material benchmark.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: I said no target from me.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Docking Vestibule. Opening image: the visit ends through Jax's ordinary route responsibility. Middle image: his definition of a good route expands to include competent detours. Closing image: the temporary visitor state physically ends.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — At the end of the visit, Jax walks the Liaison back toward docking while checking the last route segment.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison returns the temporary badge and tells Jax the route was clear.
PANEL 3 — Jax points out the unscheduled repair detour rather than accepting the compliment cleanly.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison says he handled it; Jax reframes the detour as part of the route.
PANEL 5 — Jax drops the badge into the return slot as the visitor leaves.

summary: Primary composition: 4-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: the human visit concludes successfully. Middle image: Astra keeps the institutional uncertainty alive. Closing image: central review arrives before the crew can settle.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — After the Liaison departs, the crew regroups in operations as SITE RECOMMENDATION SUBMITTED appears.
PANEL 2 — Mira says the visit went better than expected while Astra refuses to celebrate before central review responds.
PANEL 3 — Pixa announces the central acknowledgement almost immediately.
PANEL 4 — Astra opens the new attachment with the crew still gathered, carrying the visit directly into the next pressure.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: That went better than I expected.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: A person visited. Now central gets to look at it.

summary: Primary composition: 3-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: central review accepts the site while changing the terms. Middle image: a measured observation becomes a benchmark. Closing image: the operating record and the new target sit in direct conflict.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The central-review message grants a provisional limited pilot and states that a material benchmark was generated from observed site data.
PANEL 2 — TARGET MASS UPDATED appears larger beneath it; Mira immediately recognizes that the visit sample has been extrapolated.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks from the imposed target to the still-open operating record, ending the issue on the conflict the Liaison warned about.
